titlestmt.titleproper: A Guide to the Ford Foundation records, Grants H-K FA732D

profiledesc.creation: This finding aid was produced using ArchivesSpace on 2026-09-02 21:06:40 UTC.

arrangement.head: Arrangement note
arrangement.p: Each Ford Foundation Grant and the corresponding Grant File is identified by a unique Program Action (PA) number. PA numbers begin with the year a grant was made (2-digits), followed by a sequential number within that year (4-digits).

For example: PA 55-0123 was the 123rd grant made in the year 1955. PA numbers are often typed or handwritten on Ford documents in the following format: 55-123 (year)-(####). However, the Ford Foundation's grants database (LINKS) uses an 8-digit format for PA numbers: 05500123 (0YY#####).
Beginning in the 1970s the 4th digit in the 8-digit PA number was used to encode at least three different types of Ford grants:

list.item: 0YY5#### = Delegated Authority Grants (DAG) / Delegated Authority Projects (DAP)

arrangement.p: After the year 2000 a "1" is used as the first digit in the 8-digit PA number to signify the 21st century. For example the 123rd grant made in 2012 would be PA number 11200123.
Grant Files were not microfilmed in numerical order, and the Ford Foundation's LINKS database must be used to identify on which microfilm reel (or reels) any specific Grant File is housed.

arrangement.head: Arrangement note
arrangement.p: Each Ford Foundation Grant File is arranged into 4 sections:

Section 1. BASIC DOCUMENTS: Program Action Forms Accepted Proposals Tax Forms an d Certifications Docket Excerpts Request for Grant Action (RGA) Grant Notification Letter & Budget Terms of Grant Grant Acceptance Letter Supplementary Requests & Agreements Modification Requests & Agreements Section 2. PAYMENTS: Requests Letters Acknowledgments Section 3. REPORTS: Grant Status Report Forms Grantee Narrative and Financial Reports Section 4. CORRESPONDENCE: All other correspondence and material, in reverse chronological order

A possible 5th section, 'ATTACHMENTS', will contain copies of printed ephemera & clippings related to the grant. Grant Files may also be followed by a 'Grants Accounting File' which summarizes the grant.

Also, early Grant Files (roughly 1950-1970) often include a CROSS REFERENCE sheet listing other grants made in a related subject or Program Area, and a 'BIBLIOGRAPHY of GRANT-RELATED MATERIALS' at the beginning of the file.

accessrestrict.head: Conditions Governing Access
accessrestrict.p: Microfilm of grants inactive for more than 10 years are open for research with select materials restricted as noted. Brittle or damaged items are available at the discretion of RAC.

userestrict.head: Conditions Governing Use
userestrict.p: Ford Foundation has title, copyright and literary rights in the collection, in so far as it holds them.

The Rockefeller Archive Center has authority to grant permission to cite and publish material from the collection. Permission to publish extensive excerpts, or material in its entirety, will be referred to the Ford Foundation.

scopecontent.head: Scope and Contents
scopecontent.p: Section 1: Basic Documents (1956-1967), including Program Action forms, Grant Notification letters, Supplementary Requests and Modification Requests, Tax information and Pre-Grant Inquiry forms, Request for Grant Action (RGA) memos, Docket excerpts, and Memorandum of Understanding / Agreement.

Section 3: Reports, including Grant Status Report forms (1960-1968) and Grantee Narrative and Financial Reports (1956-1967), which contains lists of individual Study and Travel Award recipients' names and award amounts, but little or no information the nature of each recipient's project.

Section 4: General Correspondence (1955-1972), includes all correspondence between the Institute of International Education (IIE) and the Ford Foundation related to the Travel and Study Award program. Section 4 is continued on reel # 1678.
Section 4: General Correspondence (1955-1972), continued from reel #1677.
Section 5: Grant Attachments, including consultant files arranged in alphabetical order, with some documents (correspondence, project reports, CVs, etc.) related to individual Award recipients.
Grants Accounting File, includes copies of Program Action forms and Request for Grant Action (RGA) memos.
Reel 5954 (frame #1895-2006) includes a Ford Foundation Jakarta, Indonesia Field Office file on Travel and Study Award recipient Sutan Bakri Abbas, covering 1956-1964.
